title: 第1章 我名林天第2章 神魂归位
slug: 丹尊至上第391章驿站交接
content_zh:
青云城，林家演武场。
烈日如火，炙烤着青石板
“林天，你我婚约，今日，到此为止。”
一道清冷如冰泉的声音，自他对面那名白衣少女口中，缓缓吐出。
其名，柳嫣然。
她手持一纸婚书，那张曾让林天魂牵梦绕的绝美脸庞上，此刻却覆着一层拒人于千里之外的寒霜。
她的眼神，淡漠得如同在看一个素不相识的陌生人。
嗡——！
演武场四周，那压抑了许久的议论声，瞬间如同决堤的洪水般，轰然爆发。
那一道道或怜悯、或嘲讽、或幸灾乐祸的目光，像无数根淬了毒的细密钢针，狠狠扎进林天的灵魂深处。
果然如此！
我就说柳家不可能再忍下去了！”
“那是自然！
柳嫣然师姐如今是何等人物？东荒域七大宗门之一‘云岚宗’的内门弟子！
天之骄女！”
一个尖嘴猴腮的林家旁系子弟，语气中充满了谄媚与讨好。
“反观林天……啧啧，三年前还是咱们青云城的第一天才，可惜啊，一次炸炉，神魂受创，修为永远停在了炼气三层。
如今，不过是个连一品‘回气散’都炼不出来的废物罢了。”
“我听说，她早已与陈家少主陈风，情投意合。
陈风少爷，那可是有望在二十岁前，冲击筑基的天才！

这两人，才是天造地设的一对！
林天……算是被彻底扫进历史的垃圾堆了。”
林天死死攥着拳头，指节因为过度用力，而发出“咯咯”
的脆响，一片惨白。
他盯着柳嫣然那张曾让他魂牵梦绕的脸，如今却只感到刺骨的冰冷。
三年前，他是青云城最耀眼的天才。
十岁感应灵气，十二岁炼气，十五岁，便成功炼制出人生中第一炉一品丹药，成为青云城有史以来，最年轻的一品炼丹师！
被誉为，林家百年不出之奇才！
而那时的柳嫣然，不过是柳家一个天赋尚可的旁系女子。
这桩婚事，人人都说是柳家高攀。
可世事无常，天道无情。
一场意外的炸炉，将他从云端，狠狠地，打入了尘埃。
他的神魂，在那场爆炸中受到了无法逆转的创伤，从此，再也无法精准地操控灵力，炼丹之途，就此断绝。
而她，却如同挣脱了束缚的凤凰，得了云岚宗的橄榄枝，扶摇直上，名动青云。
云与泥，天与地。
content_en:
Qingyun City, the Lin family's martial arts arena.
The scorching sun is like fire, burning the bluestone slabs
"Lin Tian, our engagement ends today."
A voice as cold as ice spring slowly came out from the mouth of the girl in white opposite him.
Her name is Liu Yanran.
She held a marriage certificate in her hand, and her beautiful face that once fascinated Lin Tian was now covered with a layer of frost that would repel people thousands of miles away.
Her eyes were as indifferent as if she were looking at a stranger.
Buzz—!
Around the martial arts arena, the long-suppressed discussion suddenly erupted like a flood bursting from a dam.
Those glances of pity, ridicule, or gloating were like countless fine steel needles tempered with poison, piercing deeply into Lin Tian's soul.
Sure enough!
I just said that the Liu family can't bear it any longer! "
"That's natural!
What kind of person is Senior Sister Liu Yanran now? An inner disciple of the ‘Yunlan Sect’, one of the seven major sects in the Eastern Wasteland!
The proud daughter of heaven! "
A descendant of the Lin family with a sharp mouth and monkey cheeks, his tone was full of flattery and flattery.
"On the other hand, Lin Tian... tsk tsk, he was the number one genius in our Qingyun City three years ago. It's a pity that a furnace explosion damaged his soul and his cultivation was permanently stuck at the third level of Qi Refining.
Now, he is nothing more than a waste that cannot even refine a first-grade 'Returning Qi Powder'. "
"I heard that she has already been in love with Chen Feng, the young master of the Chen family.
Young Master Chen Feng is a genius who is expected to achieve foundation building before he is twenty years old!
These two are a match made in heaven!
Lin Tian... was completely swept into the trash heap of history. "
Lin Tian clenched his fists tightly, and his knuckles "clucked" due to excessive force.
There was a crisp sound, and everything was pale.
He stared at Liu Yanran's face that once haunted him in dreams, but now he only felt a biting coldness.
Three years ago, he was the most dazzling genius in Qingyun City.
He sensed spiritual energy at the age of ten and refined it at the age of twelve. At the age of fifteen, he successfully refined the first batch of first-grade elixirs in his life, becoming the youngest first-grade alchemist in the history of Qingyun City!
Known as a genius that has not been produced in the Lin family for a century!
At that time, Liu Yanran was just a talented sideline girl from the Liu family.
Everyone said that this marriage was a high-profile affair of the Liu family.
But things in the world are unpredictable and the way of heaven is ruthless.
An unexpected furnace explosion knocked him from the clouds into dust.
His soul suffered irreversible trauma in that explosion. From then on, he could no longer control spiritual power accurately, and his path to alchemy was cut off.
But she, like a phoenix that broke free from its restraints, got an olive branch from the Yunlan Sect, soared to the top, and became famous in the world.
Clouds and mud, sky and earth.
